I have built a 30,000+ follower community across Instagram and YouTube (4,000+ subscribers) teaching people how to build AI agents, apps, and automation systems using no-code and code-based tools. I run a paid Skool community with complete courses, 7,000+ templates, and weekly live builds where I guide learners through building real systems from scratch. projects.name: Real systems I have built, deployed, and teach from. Each demonstrates a different part of the AI stack:
AssureIQ — Clinical Decision Support | Full AI Stack | 2024–2026
Covers: Data cleaning, feature engineering, classical ML, model evaluation, explainability, LLM integration (RAG), model deployment, MLOps, monitoring. Published research.

24 ML models (XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest). SHAP explainability. False negative reduction from ~20% to <3% through SMOTE/ADASYN and threshold optimisation. Claude API RAG pipeline with confidence scoring. FastAPI deployment with <500ms latency, health monitoring, and audit trails.
Stack: Python · FastAPI · scikit-learn · XGBoost · Claude API · Whisper · PostgreSQL · Docker
AssureXRay — Deep Learning Image Classification | Deep Learning Focus | 2026
Covers: Deep learning architectures, training pipelines, transfer learning, inference, explainability.
5-experiment benchmark grid (EfficientNet-B0/B3, ResNet-50-CBAM). 81.4% accuracy, 0.846 macro AUC. Grad-CAM explainability with IoU validation. Annotation-guided training. Reproducible pipeline.
Stack: PyTorch · torchvision · timm · Albumentations · Grad-CAM · Streamlit
AI Hedge Fund — Multi-Agent System | LLMs, RAG & Agents Focus | 2025–2026
Covers: LLM orchestration, agent workflows, tool-calling, multi-agent reasoning, API integration. 2.4M+ views.
7 autonomous agents with distinct reasoning, tool-calling to real-time APIs, and collaborative decision-making. Custom orchestration layer. Deployed for UAE enterprise clients.
Stack: Python · n8n · OpenAI GPT-4 · Polygon.io · PostgreSQL
GoldQuant — Algorithmic Trading System | Data & Deployment Focus | 2026
Covers: Data pipelines, ETL, schema design, production deployment, monitoring, error recovery. Open source: 19 stars.
ETL processing 112MB+ data. 10-table PostgreSQL schema. Event-driven engine (~17,000 lines). Async distribution. Full Pytest test suite.
Stack: Python · PostgreSQL · Supabase · Pandas · Polygon.io · OANDA API · Pytest
Glen Luna — AI Discovery Platform | End-to-End System Design | 2025–Present

Full-stack AI system: 7+ API orchestration, Claude API for structured analysis, Next.js 14 frontend, Supabase Auth, Vitest + Playwright testing. Demonstrates end-to-end AI system design and demo delivery.
Stack: Next.js 14 · TypeScript · Supabase · Claude API · Vercel
